capabilities.description: Public advertising page with stats, embedded HTML, and signed-token catalog browsing.

global_config_schema.title: Catalog token secret
global_config_schema.description: Optional HMAC secret for signing public catalog access links. Leave empty to let the plugin generate and persist a secret automatically. If provided, use at least 32 random bytes.

global_config_schema.title: Advanced listen address
global_config_schema.description: Optional advanced listener address, e.g. 127.0.0.1:8090. If set, this overrides Public port. Prefer loopback behind a reverse proxy.

global_config_schema.title: Public port
global_config_schema.description: Optional standalone public website port, for example 8090. The plugin listens on :PORT when this is set and no advanced listen address is provided.

global_config_schema.title: Public base URL
global_config_schema.description: Optional absolute URL used when generated catalog links are returned.

global_config_schema.title: Catalog password
global_config_schema.description: Shared password required to browse /catalog unless a permanent bypass token is used.

global_config_schema.title: Initial trusted HTML
global_config_schema.description: Optional initial trusted operator HTML. After setup, edit the published landing-page HTML from the plugin admin section.

global_config_schema.title: Ebook portal installation ID
global_config_schema.description: Optional Continuum plugin installation ID for continuum.ebooks. Enables ebook stats and browsing through authenticated inter-plugin HTTP.

global_config_schema.title: Audiobook portal installation ID
global_config_schema.description: Optional Continuum plugin installation ID for continuum.audiobooks. Enables audiobook stats and browsing through authenticated inter-plugin HTTP.
